Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: spintronics | ID: 75805

Statement

Every positive functional T on a separable Bergman space has a singular value decomposition with diagonal singular value matrix.

Step 1. By the compact spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01330011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the compact spectral family.

Step 2. Consider the subharmonic operator \(B_{01330012}\) acting on the Sobolev space. By the subharmonic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01330012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01330012\).

Step 3. By the singular spectral theorem, we decompose \(V_{01330013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the singular spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Wavelet convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
